native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (West Africa, final result)

lead-research-for-action-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity running studies on sources of lead exposure in low- and middle-income countries, so governments and others can act on them, modelled for West Africa. The idea Lead Research for Action was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its final cost per DALY equivalent.

labri-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity advocating for regulation of used lead-acid battery recycling, modelled for Thailand, counting health and income gains from lower lead exposure. The idea LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative) was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its final cost per DALY equivalent; the published report gave about $42 per DALY ($17 per income doubling) from an earlier version.

first-embrace-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 update of its estimate for a new charity scaling up kangaroo care for low birth weight babies by embedding it in hospitals, modelled for Pakistan. The idea First Embrace was founded to run (First Embrace works in Nigeria). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the final cost per DALY averted per successful charity (about $50).

oxygen-access-project-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate for a new charity that distributes and maintains oxygen concentrators and pulse oximeters so hospitals can treat childhood pneumonia, modelled for Nigeria. The idea Oxygen Access Project was founded to run. A re-implementation of the 2024 updated CEA in AIM's spreadsheet, which AIM marks as superseding the 2023 report's model, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $173 per DALY averted (the 2023 report quoted $38 to $79).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Sierra Leone, including under-5 benefits)

opal-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity that trains community workers to run participatory learning and action groups for pregnant women and mothers, cutting maternal, newborn and child deaths, modelled for Sierra Leone. The idea Opal Health was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as corrected in August 2024, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $56 per DALY averted.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Nepal, myCOPD partnership model)

respira-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate for a new charity that partners with a digital app to give pulmonary rehabilitation to people recently hospitalised with COPD, modelled for Nepal. The idea Respira Health was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $84 per DALY averted (the report's range is $9 to $84 across countries).

native.unit: $ per QALY gained (scenario 2: low-income country, new workbooks, paid telephone support)

kaya-guides-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity offering guided self-help for depression: a workbook plus short phone support from lay workers. The idea Kaya Guides was founded to run. Its bottom line is the total cost per QALY gained in the report's most likely low-income-country scenario, with counterfactual costs; we read a QALY gained as a DALY averted.

better-season-project-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate (2026 idea report) for a new charity helping smallholder farmers in Kenya get low-risk loans secured on the asset they buy, such as a water tank. The idea Better Season Project was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per year of doubled household consumption, including the chance the charity fails.

native.unit: years of doubled consumption per $1,000 (expected, with 56% chance of success)

better-futures-guide-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new evaluator that finds and recommends highly cost-effective livelihoods charities, moving donors' money to them. The idea Better Futures Guide was founded to run. Its bottom line is the years of doubled consumption per $1,000 of the evaluator's costs, from new and shifted donations, weighted by its chance of success.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (50% tobacco excise increase, Mongolia)

concentric-policies-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity advocating for higher tobacco taxes, here a 50% rise in Mongolia's tobacco excise, the first of the four country-and-ask tabs the report costs. The idea Concentric Policies was founded to run. A re-implementation of that tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and the government's costs ($51; the report's range, $39 to $51, is this tab's charity-only and charity-plus-government figures).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (advocacy for the US PASTEUR Act and similar pull incentives elsewhere)

alliance-for-reducing-microbial-resistan.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity advocating for subscription-style pull incentives (the US PASTEUR Act, and similar schemes in other rich countries) that pay for new antibiotics against drug-resistant infections. The idea ARMoR was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and governments' costs ($110); the report gave $90.80 from an earlier version, and $0.10 counting the charity's costs alone.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Uttar Pradesh, India, final result)

neev-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity training brick kiln owners and operators in northern India to run zigzag kilns more efficiently, cutting the fine particles and sulphur dioxide that harm people's health. The idea Neev was founded to run (AIM's 2026 cohort). A re-implementation of the health tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its final cost per DALY averted in Uttar Pradesh ($315); the climate benefit AIM estimates on a separate tab (about $2 per tonne of CO2) is left out, so the result counts health only.
